decisions.quote: Overall, we replicated the original study ﬁndings for the effect of maximal anaerobic fatigue on anterior reach distance in a Y-Balance Test.
decisions.reason: Per the SSRC selection protocol, this replication specifically targeted anterior reach distance as the primary dependent variable (the only reach direction for which the original statistics could be reproduced for the formal replication z-test), and the intact abstract conclusion states an explicit overall verdict that the original findings for anterior reach distance were replicated.
